name: skywatch
description: A sky behind the chat that follows the sun where you are, with a small sun or a moon in its real phase, and a little critter above the prompt that snoozes, dreams now and then, and wakes to point you at sessions that have finished.

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Where you are, in degrees north (negative for south), for real sunrise and sunset. Two decimal places is plenty. Leave it and longitude empty for a plain 06:00 to 18:00 day.

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: Where you are, in degrees east (negative for west).
